mapper.sql: FROM student_post sp INNER JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN stall s ON s.id = sp.stall_id LEFT JOIN canteen c ON c.id = sp.canteen_id LEFT JOIN canteen sc ON sc.id = s.canteen_id LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = sp.category_id

sp.id, sp.user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS userNickname, su.avatar_url AS userAvatar, COALESCE(sp.canteen_id, s.canteen_id) AS canteenId, COALESCE(c.name, sc.name) AS canteenName, COALESCE(c.type, sc.type) AS canteenType, sp.stall_id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, sp.category_id AS categoryId, cg.name AS categoryName, sp.title, sp.dish_name AS foodName, sp.shop_name AS shopName, sp.content, sp.price, sp.score, sp.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, sp.is_join_lottery AS isJoinLottery, sp.view_count AS viewCount, sp.like_count AS likeCount, sp.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, sp.comment_count AS commentCount, sp.status, sp.created_at AS createdAt, sp.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY sp.like_count DESC, sp.favorite_count DESC, sp.id DESC
ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC, sp.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT
WHERE sp.id = #{id} AND sp.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND su.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM canteen WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stall s INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = s.canteen_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN'
AND s.canteen_id = #{canteenId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM category WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO student_post_image (post_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES
(#{postId}, #{image}, #{index})

INSERT INTO lottery_pool ( source_type, source_id, merchant_id, canteen_id, stall_id, category_id, title, price, score, cover_image_url, recommend_reason, weight, status ) SELECT 'POST', sp.id, NULL, COALESCE(sp.canteen_id, st.canteen_id), sp.stall_id, sp.category_id, sp.dish_name, sp.price, sp.score, sp.cover_image_url, CONCAT('User post: ', sp.shop_name), 100, CASE WHEN sp.is_join_lottery = 1 AND sp.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END FROM student_post sp LEFT JOIN stall st ON st.id = sp.stall_id WHERE sp.id = #{postId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE canteen_id = VALUES(canteen_id), stall_id = VALUES(stall_id), category_id = VALUES(category_id), title = VALUES(title), price = VALUES(price), score = VALUES(score), cover_image_url = VALUES(cover_image_url), recommend_reason = VALUES(recommend_reason), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE lottery_pool SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE source_type = 'POST' AND source_id = #{postId}
